attempts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one proposed source-only adult humanoid FRONT DESIGN REFERENCE, a single full-figure premium collectible-style character, portrait canvas.
Primary request: Create one ORIGINAL adult human urban sports-equipment vigilante and ranged-support companion. Broad athletic adult male build, natural seven-and-a-half-head proportions, long dark shoulder-length hair. A simple ivory-white protective hockey mask covers his face, with small practical ventilation slots and eye apertures, no painted symbols. Charcoal sleeveless padded utility vest with understated horizontal stitched panels, indigo work trousers, scuffed dark brown work boots. Plain small sports bag strapped securely behind the back, with just a modest side glimpse and its plain strap visible. Exactly one wooden hockey stick; no other equipment protrudes from the bag.
Reference roles: The previously inspected Raphael project image informs ONLY collectible cohort, restrained charcoal/earth material palette, tactile finish and studio presentation. The previously inspected Medusa quality image informs ONLY sculptural detail, believable materials and finish quality. Do not copy either reference's identity, anatomy, costume, headgear, weapons or pose wholesale. This subject is a human, with no turtle shell, animal features, red bandanna, sai, classical armor or snakes.
Pose and hands: Strict straight-on FRONT, orthographic reference elevation. Head, mask, chest, pelvis and both boots face directly toward the viewer, level shoulders, no body twist. Relaxed stable stance with feet separated. Both elbows softly bent and arms held away from the torso, with continuous visible charcoal-background gaps around arms and legs. Anatomical RIGHT hand, appearing on the LEFT side of the image, visibly and naturally grips the hockey-stick shaft around hip height; shaft angles downward and outward to image-left, well away from both legs. Show its complete wooden shaft and hooked hockey blade, no cropping. Anatomical LEFT hand on image-right is empty and relaxed, palm angled slightly forward with five anatomically plausible fingers visible and clearly separated from the trousers. Right thumb wraps naturally opposite the fingers; no fused hands, doubled digits, hidden grips or extra limbs.
Framing: One centered full figure including all hair, full mask, both hands, both boots, whole stick and entire pedestal. Hair/headgear top at approximately 6 percent of canvas height with a clear top margin. Pedestal bottom exactly at approximately 90 percent of canvas height, leaving a clear 10 percent charcoal margin below. Keep the full figure and stick inside the frame with generous side clearance. Do not let hair, stick or bag invade the top margin.
Pedestal: Exactly ONE round dark stone pedestal made of exactly TWO stacked shallow circular discs. Show it strictly EDGE-ON as two horizontal narrow stone bands with straight horizontal upper and lower edges; the camera has no downward angle. NO visible top surface, NO top ellipse, no oval ground platform, no third disc. Both boots visibly meet the upper straight edge. The base is a simple support only.
Scene/backdrop: Uniform plain charcoal studio background, no ground plane, scenery, ground shadow or vignette props.
Style and materials: Highly resolved original sculptural character design, realistic stylized premium miniature/PBR concept finish, clear anatomy and large readable material groups, restrained neutral studio light. Natural skin texture, subtle cloth weave and padding seams, worn indigo fabric, restrained boot scuffs, unbranded warm wood grain. Maintain clean silhouette edges without glow.
Constraints: One subject only; one front view only; no three-quarter view, no perspective foreshortening, no overhead view, no inset details. No VFX, action effects, smoke, fire, floating particles, diorama scene, text, labels, logos, UI, watermark, actor likeness, recognizable franchise insignia or copied franchise key art. The confirmed range mechanic is metadata and does not require extra visible weapons.
